Proposed 2027 quarterly meeting dates
Summit Ridge Logistics and Greenbriar

Dear Karen,

Thank you for hosting us again next year. We would like to hold the four quarterly meetings at your office, 1700 Lincoln Street, Suite 2400, Denver, CO 80203. Each meeting runs four hours, followed by dinner nearby. The options below work for Alan Whitfield, Maria Castellano, David Okafor and Susan Lindqvist.

Please pick one option per quarter and reply by {{replyBy}}. If none of them work, tell us and we will look again.

Q1, January to March
  Option 1: Tue Jan 12, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Tue Jan 26, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Mon Feb 22, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q2, April to June
  Option 1: Tue May 25, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed May 5, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Tue May 11, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q3, July to September (only 2 days worked for all partners)
  Option 1: Wed Aug 11, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Mon Aug 30, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Q4, October to December
  Option 1: Wed Oct 13, 10am to 2pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 2: Wed Oct 27, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.
  Option 3: Tue Oct 19, 9am to 1pm. Dinner at 6:30pm.

Your board members will be asked to confirm once you have chosen.

We look forward to seeing you.
Executive Assistant to the Greenbriar Partners
